Nothing in the record ties the distress to acquired-product-versus-operations incoherence (p4) or to operations fracturing against people/management/culture (p5); the asset sale to Texegy and transfer of operatorship is a bankruptcy-driven disposition, not documented integration failure. Because the slice provides no evidence bearing on either interface pathway, both are coded uncertain rather than 0.
